basic_info.description: Haight Ashbury - Modern Style with Victorian Charm.   This Luxury Full Floor Flat has been remodeled with a Contemporary Concept and Floor Plan. A spacious Foyer leads to the 3 Bedrooms, Laundry Room, Designer Style Full Bath with separate Soaking Tub and Glass enclosed shower, and an additional Water Closet.  Then at the back of the flat with natural light and outlooks to the shared yard / garden is the Stylish Kitchen with Center Island that is open to the Spacious and Bright Living Room as well as the Formal Dining Area.  Other features include Stainless Steel appliances, sleek cabinetry, stone counters, tile and wood flooring, updated light fixtures, and numerous Victorian details. There is a separate water heater, and force air gas heater, circuit breakers, and exclusive use storage area in the basement.   Located a  block to the Panhandle, steps to Haight Street, and Cole Valley adjacent make this a must have Location with its vibrant, desirable, and city central neighborhood. Quick Condo Conversion / Lottery Bypass'' potential for this 35% undivided TIC interest.
